questions.question: Compare the security mechanisms available in Windows with those available in UNIX, focusing on the strengths and weaknesses of each. Provide six (6) distinct points of comparison.

marking_points.point: Remote access VPNs provide individual hosts or clients with remote and secure access to an organization network.
marking_points.quote: Provides remote and secure access to an organization network to individual hosts or clients

marking_points.point: Zero Trust Network Access restricts a user to only the access and permission required to fulfill the role.

marking_points.point: IDS monitors network resources to detect intrusions and attacks that preventive techniques such as firewalls, proxy servers, packet-filtering routers and network segmentations failed to stop.
